description: This file defines a React-like component called 'Home' using the Lightning.js framework. It manages layout and UI logic for the home page, including state synchronization with a store, component composition, and rendering logic with conditional visibility based on state.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing the home page layout. It manages the display of notes, editor, and navigation components, and synchronizes its state with a central store.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is mounted; sets up store subscription and initial sync.

methods.name: destroyed
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is destroyed; cleans up store subscription.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Method that synchronizes the component's internal state with the data from the store.
